name: Graph composition trigger and lineage simulator
target: Simulate starting a separate target graph run from a parent run with declared input validation and Nexus run-ledger lineage.
inputs: A fake target graph declaring required typed inputs
A parent run that triggers the target
observations: Missing or wrong-type inputs refuse before a child run or ledger row is created
The target receives the supplied inputs in its own run
Fire mode lets the parent finish while the child remains pending
Await mode returns after the separate child run finishes
Nexus run-ledger rows link childRunId to parentRunId
